hero.headline: Hi, I'm Monisha! A Product Designer making complex things feel simple
hero.intro: I'm a NYC-based designer working at the intersection of product strategy, UX, and technology. With 4+ years of experience across enterprise SaaS, AI-powered tools, and consumer products, I turn complex workflows and data-rich systems into intuitive, human-centered experiences that drive measurable impact.

projects.name: Rokt
projects.title: Turn scattered churn signals into a shared retention workflow
projects.summary: I replaced fragmented reporting with automated signal capture, an account-manager review step, and a centralized dashboard—helping stakeholders prepare retention action plans faster.
projects.alt: Rokt competitive-intelligence demo with risk trends, account metrics, and review activity. All shown data is fictional.
projects.caption: Interactive demo · Fictional accounts and financial figures

home.title: Turning conversations into retention intelligence
home.summary: An AI-powered workflow that automates churn-risk detection, centralizes competitive insights, and helps teams respond before customers leave.

projects.name: Block Party
projects.title: Make neighborhood proposals easier to explore and shape
projects.summary: An interactive community planning prototype helps younger Bloomington residents explore projects, create visual proposals, vote, and share feedback. Testing surfaced qualitative feedback and improvements to the proposal builder.
projects.outcomeLabel: tested the prototype and saw potential for inclusive participation
projects.alt: Block Party mobile prototype with a neighborhood map, project sheet, and bottom navigation.
projects.caption: Capstone prototype · Qualitative feedback, not measured participation growth

home.title: Reimagining how communities shape neighborhoods
home.summary: A gamified mobile experience that empowers residents to visualize neighborhood changes, propose ideas, and shape the future of their communities.

projects.name: iHeart Media
projects.title: Making digital audio more personal and interactive for the next generation of listeners
projects.summary: A redesigned listening experience that simplifies onboarding, personalizes discovery, and brings listeners closer through social interactions.
projects.alt: iHeart Media listening home concept from the studio team project.
projects.caption: Shared studio project · Online user testing with 45+ users
